purpose: Specify how the released molecule is transported through CSF to a detection site accessible to a wearable sensor.

specification.transport_path: Ventricular CSF -> spinal canal CSF -> lumbar puncture site OR -> arachnoid granulations -> venous blood -> subcutaneous interstitial fluid
specification.transport_distance_cm: 30-50 (ventricle to lumbar) OR 50-100 (ventricle to systemic circulation to skin)
specification.attenuation_factor: 1/10 to 1/1000 (concentration at detection site << concentration at release site)
specification.spatial_resolution_mm: 10-50 (wearable sensor integrates over a region, not a point)

key_physics_question: Does the molecule reach a wearable-detectable site (e.g., lumbar subcutaneous, or scalp) in clinically useful time (minutes, not hours) AND at detectable concentration (nM range)?
what_unfreezes_this: Step 1 (molecule — determines diffusion coefficient, binding to CSF proteins, metabolism) AND in silico CSF flow modeling.
modeling_required: CSF flow simulation (anatomically accurate ventricular + spinal canal geometry)
Diffusion simulation for the specific molecule (Stokes-Einstein, with CSF viscosity 1.0 cP)
Convective transport simulation (CSF bulk flow ~0.3 mL/min, but pulsatile oscillation dominates mixing)
Patient variability: model across 10 virtual patients with different ventricular anatomy
estimated_time_to_unblock: 3-6 months of CFD + diffusion modeling, after molecule selected
status_provenance: MODEL_DERIVED from CSF physiology + diffusion physics
